name: EPIC 205921032
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.4 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,046 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.85 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,715 K at its surface.
